text: でんじはを　つかうと　あいての　ポケモンは　まひして　わざが　でにくく　なるわ！

structure.jp: でんじはを　つかうと
あいての　ポケモンは　まひして
structure.en: the opponent's Pokémon gets paralyzed, and

structure.jp: わざが　でにくく　なるわ！
structure.en: its moves become hard to get out!

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'when this happens, that always follows'. つかうと = 'when you use it'.

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい stuck onto a verb says the action is hard to do. でにくい = 'hard to come out'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. でにくく　なる = 'become hard to come out'.
